##### Project general facts

Timber Terrace is an elegant residential project, offering a refined lifestyle in a well-planned community. The development features a carefully selected collection of one, two, and three-bedroom apartments, each thoughtfully crafted with quality finishes, spacious layouts, and attention to detail. Developed by Vakson Development, a trusted name with over five decades of success in Dubai, Timber Terrace combines modern living with excellent long-term value.

Residents enjoy an impressive rooftop amenity experience, thoughtfully curated to enhance daily life. Amenities include a fully equipped gym, a partially covered swimming pool with sunken beds, a jacuzzi, a children's pool, a pickleball court, family seating areas, a jogging track, kids' play zones, and a business center. Every element is designed to create spaces for both relaxation and recreation, ensuring residents can balance work and leisure seamlessly within the community.

Every apartment at Timber Terrace features modern finishing with high-quality materials and fully equipped kitchens. The interiors are designed with spacious layouts and attention to detail, creating warm and inviting homes that suit different lifestyles and family needs. The thoughtful design and quality craftsmanship ensure that each residence is a sanctuary of comfort and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Dubai South, a dynamic and strategically planned district located in the southern part of Dubai, this exceptional location serves as a major hub for economic, commercial, and logistical activities. The area's standout feature is its proximity to Al Maktoum International Airport, the world's largest airport in terms of cargo volume, making it a key player in global logistics and aviation.

The location is distinguished by its world-class infrastructure and commitment to sustainability. Dubai South is home to the Dubai Expo 2020 site, which has transitioned into a legacy district offering residential communities, educational institutions, and recreational facilities. The area's focus on eco-friendly urban planning and energy-efficient buildings creates a forward-thinking environment for residents and businesses alike.

For those seeking a residence that embodies strategic connectivity, sustainable living, and strong investment potential, Dubai South delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of logistical excellence, modern infrastructure, and a dynamic community makes it one of Dubai's most compelling destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of forward-thinking living — connected, convenient and effortlessly inspiring.
